summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Arsip Digital. Backend: 32 pytest cases across auth, users, archive-types, archive-locations, archives CRUD, PDF upload/download via Emergent object storage, stats, and RBAC -> 28 passed / 4 failed (all 4 are unhandled-500 robustness bugs). Frontend: all 9 requested flows verified via Playwright on the public preview URL and ALL PASSED - admin login + wrong-password error, 5 stats cards, Tambah Arsip with PDF + success toast + form reset, Cari Arsip search/Buka/Unduh/Ubah edit persisted, Hapus Arsip with confirm dialog, Pengaturan (create user, add+delete jenis, add+delete lokasi), regular-user role gating (Hapus/Pengaturan menus hidden, direct URL /hapus and /pengaturan redirect to /dashboard, no 'Ubah' button, but Tambah + Buka + Unduh work), and logout redirect to /login.

critical.issue: Search params are injected directly into a MongoDB $regex without escaping. Special regex chars (e.g. '([a') raise re.error inside PyMongo and return HTTP 500. Also a ReDoS/regex-injection vector. Fix: re.escape() the user input.

minor.issue: ObjectId(archive_id) is called on raw path param -> bson.errors.InvalidId uncaught -> HTTP 500 for any malformed id (e.g. /api/archives/abc123). Should return 400/404.
Same unvalidated ObjectId pattern (not asserted but identical code path) -> will 500 on malformed id.

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}' on the Ubah dialog - add AlertDialogDescription/aria-describedby.
A success toast from Tambah Arsip was still visible after logout + re-login as a different user; consider clearing toasts on route/auth change (cosmetic).

action_items: Escape user input with re.escape() before building the $regex in GET /api/archives (currently returns 500 on regex metacharacters).

Add a shared helper to validate/parse ObjectId path params (ObjectId.is_valid) and raise HTTPException(400/404) instead of letting bson.InvalidId bubble to a 500. Applies to archives GET/PUT/DELETE, archive-types DELETE, archive-locations DELETE, users DELETE.
Add AlertDialogDescription/aria-describedby to the CariArsip Ubah DialogContent to clear the React a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: no ObjectId validation anywhere - every {id} route is a guaranteed 500 on malformed input.
search_archives builds $regex from raw query strings: regex injection + 500s. Use re.escape().

update_archive computes `old = doc.get('stored_file')` but never deletes the replaced object from object storage -> orphaned PDFs leak on every edit; delete_archive likewise leaves the stored PDF behind.
No password strength/length validation on POST /api/users (empty password is rejected, but '1' is accepted).

Playbook items not implemented (may be out of scope for this username-based design): no brute-force lockout after N failed logins, no forgot/reset-password flow. Login is unthrottled, and the default admin/admin credentials are printed on the login page - flag for production.
seed_admin behaviour is correct: it re-hashes and updates the existing admin when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (verified in code); admin hash confirmed bcrypt '$2b$'.
CORS uses an explicit FRONTEND_URL origin with allow_credentials=True (good), and login sets an httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie (verified in response headers).
seed_data_creation: All test data was created with TEST_ / test_ prefixes and removed afterwards via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py (archives TEST_*, users test_ui_*, jenis/lokasi TEST_*). No seeded data modified.
test_credentials: admin/admin (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, works). Regular users created during test were cleaned up; recreate via Pengaturan > Input User if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/ (conftest.py fixtures: api_client, admin_token, admin_client, test_credentials parsed from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest . -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. The only 4 failing tests are test_get_invalid_objectid, test_delete_invalid_objectid[types/locations] and test_search_regex_injection_safe - all 500s from unvalidated input; they will pass once the ObjectId/re.escape fixes land. Playwright gotchas: Pengaturan role select options read 'User (input, buka, unduh)' / 'Admin (akses penuh)' (NOT 'Pengguna'); default is already 'user' so no selection needed. Jenis/Lokasi delete confirm uses a generic [role=alertdialog] button 'Hapus' (no data-testid on that confirm button - consider adding one). Named-item testids: types-input/add-types-button/types-list/types-item-{id}/delete-types-{id} (same with 'locations').
rca_of_the_issue: Both failure classes are missing input validation in /app/backend/server.py. (1) Every {id} route calls bson ObjectId(id) directly; a non-hex id raises bson.errors.InvalidId which FastAPI converts to a 500 (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: "bson.errors.InvalidId: 'abc123' is not a valid ObjectId"). Repro: GET /api/archives/abc123 with a valid admin Bearer token -> 500. (2) search_archives passes the raw nomor/nama query strings into {"$regex": value}; unbalanced regex metacharacters raise re.error -> 500. Repro: GET /api/archives?nomor=([a -> 500. Mitigation: guard with ObjectId.is_valid() (raise 400) and wrap search terms in re.escape().
